chain: The tree follows the paper's route all the way to the main bound. It builds the scalar exchange network, frames, subset labels and the dimension budget, then the bit shear and complex phase interfaces with s<Wm and the exponent 1-2^{-50}. These feed the interchange recurrence and the butterfly-layer recurrence, which are then used in the synthetic-transform, resampling, chirp, CRT and twist reductions, with exact recovery and the cost table giving O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). The thinnest point is the elementary stream lemma, which S2.1 quotes without proof; no link of the chain is missing.

steps.note: Gives h=100, v=binom(100,3), N=v^3 and m=h^3=10^6. Data lines are indexed by triples a (U_a=t_{a1}⊗t_{a2}⊗t_{a3}), one triple coordinate per stage. The network sends (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and restores every scratch wire for arbitrary initial values.

A common invertible frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the route operator depends only on the endpoint frames, so intermediate frames are chosen to make edges cheap.

Nondegenerate labels in F^{⊗3} of dimension m, nested on every edge, with the only decreasing edges the central 3->4 edges, each losing h (P⊗F⊗Q). Orthogonality of neighbouring triple lines is used on the side edge 2->5.
For nested U⊂V, P_V-P_U has rank dim V-dim U. The N edges leaving the X_a sources have matrix 2P_{U_a} of rank one where the dimension did not change, which adds N.
The signed changes telescope to Wm-2N, the absolute sum is Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and s_b=(Wm-2N+2L_b)+N=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L/N=3ch/v gives 100/539 and 101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b>0 (and 2N-2L_c>0) and s<Wm.
M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m, using P_{U_a^⊥}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m for X_a and 0->I for the other roles. With Phi_M frames, every role, scratch rows included, gets the shear H<-H+D.
A rank-a shear factors as E_1 Π E_2 and costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V), with each one of Π done by one interchange between two controlled updates. So a node makes s recursive calls in all.

Children have volume V/W, so F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1). With s/W<m^tau and tau=1-2^{-50}, obtained from eta>20·2^{-50} and log m<20, the result is F_k=O(e^tau). The fixed-tape schedule adds only O(V) per node.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the whole central chain with its defining content: the fixed h=100 network exchanging the banks, frames commuting with gates, nested subset labels with the only loss on central 3->4 edges, rank equal to the dimension change plus N source ranks, the budget W_b m-N+2L_b, L/N=100/539<1/2, the endpoint identity I_m, rank-a shears costing a recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. All nine steps are reconstructed.
